items.title: Deadline to file Einspruch (objection) against the tax assessment
items.quote: Der Einspruch muss innerhalb eines Monats beim Finanzamt Beispielhain eingehen; die Frist beginnt mit dem Tag nach der Bekanntgabe.
items.computation: Letter dated Thu 5 Jun 2025, sent by ordinary post by a tax authority: under § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO it counts as delivered (bekanntgegeben) on the 4th day after posting, i.e. Mon 9 Jun 2025; that day is Pfingstmontag (a nationwide public holiday), so delivery shifts to the next working day, Tue 10 Jun 2025 (§ 108 Abs. 3 AO). The one-month Einspruch period (§ 355 Abs. 1 AO) begins the day after delivery (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB / § 108 Abs. 1 AO), i.e. 11 Jun 2025, and ends one month later on the day with the same number, Thu 10 Jul 2025 (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB). 10 Jul 2025 is a Thursday and not a holiday in NRW, so the deadline stays at that date.

items.title: Tax refund to be credited by the Finanzamt
items.quote: Er wird in den nächsten Tagen gutgeschrieben.
items.computation: The letter states the refund of 679,00 € will be credited to the given IBAN 'in den nächsten Tagen' (within the next few days) after the 5 Jun 2025 notice, but gives no exact calendar date, so a precise due date cannot be determined; this is a credit owed to the recipient, not an action required of them.

warnings: The refund IBAN (DE81 2655 0105 0071 8300 46) is a well-formed German IBAN, but this says nothing about ownership; the recipient should confirm it matches their own account.
